# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Hellvault Rad-Slayer Run** as a browser-native mobile one-tap endless runner. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: start button, tap/Space grounded jump, gravity physics, right-to-left hazards and collectibles, score only on collectible pickup, slight speed increase per pickup, padded AABB collision, failure on hazard, and restart flow.

Transform all presentation into an unhinged Fallout-inspired demon-slayer identity. The player is a gas-masked Rad-Slayer sprinting across Vault 666's radioactive frontage road. Collect glowing brimstone bottlecaps, dodge horned demon pylons, and show `CAPS PURGED` as the score. Use procedural Canvas art for the wasteland skyline, nuclear glow, vault gears, warning-striped road, demon hazards, caps, particles, and slayer silhouette. Use Creepster for horror title copy and VT323 for terminal HUD text. Keep mobile CTAs large and readable.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Hellvault Rad-Slayer Run

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a mobile-first one-tap canvas endless runner. The player starts from a menu, taps/clicks/presses Space to jump, moves through a side-scrolling scene, collects floating rewards for score, dodges ground hazards, and restarts after collision failure.

## Protected mechanic truth
- **Input:** Start/restart buttons use click/tap; active play uses pointerdown or Space for one jump only when grounded.
- **Physics:** Gravity-driven vertical jump with a grounded state; no double-jump.
- **Loop:** `requestAnimationFrame` update/draw loop with capped delta time.
- **Movement:** Player stays near the left side; obstacles and collectibles scroll right-to-left.
- **Spawning:** Periodic spawn cadence creates either a ground hazard or aerial collectible.
- **Collision:** Forgiving AABB hit checks with padding.
- **Score/progression:** Score increments only when collecting an item; speed multiplier increases slightly per collection.
- **Failure/restart:** Hitting a hazard ends play, shows score, and allows restart.

## Remix trajectory
The source dog/snack skyline becomes an unhinged Fallout-inspired demon-slayer sprint through a radioactive bunker wasteland. The player is a trench-coated demon slayer leaping over mutated demon totems while collecting glowing brimstone caps. Mechanics remain identical; meaning, HUD, world language, procedural art, background, feedback, and media are rebuilt.

## Canonical rebuilt surface
`index.html` is the new public surface. `index_old.html` remains reference-only evidence.
